claims.current_evidence: scene.py, illuminant.py, color.py, ROI helpers, chart/scene tests
claims.gap_detail: Scene capture calibration and measured illumination traces remain external evidence.
claims.ppt_claim: Spectral scenes, reflectance bases, calibration charts, spatial patterns, and ROI extraction.
claims.recommended_action: Keep as validated research scene generation, not measured capture truth.

claims.current_evidence: optics.py, lens_patents.py, RayOptics geometric PSF registry
claims.gap_detail: RayOptics PSF is geometric; flare/coating/tolerance and measured PSF are not implemented.
claims.ppt_claim: Diffraction/WVF, raytrace PSF/OTF, distortion, cos4 falloff, depth/defocus.
claims.recommended_action: Use diffraction/WVF comparisons and measured PSF evidence before calibration promotion.

claims.gap_detail: Sensor DB is metadata-derived; per-sensor calibrated process deck and sensor-specific LUTs are missing.
claims.ppt_claim: CFA, pixel/photodiode, exposure, noise, FDTD optical LUT, TCAD collection proxy, RAW output.
claims.recommended_action: Use analytic sweeps for exploration and FDTD/TCAD batches only for short-listed candidates.

claims.gap_detail: Advanced production ISP blocks such as HDR/TNR tuning are proxy or not complete.
claims.ppt_claim: Demosaic, sensor conversion, AWB, CCM, tone/gamma, display render.
claims.recommended_action: Keep current ISP as research image-processing pipeline.

claims.current_evidence: hwisp.py, hwisp_db.py, goal gate HW ISP smoke
claims.gap_detail: Profiles are seed/public-derived; no board trace, hardware counter, or vendor BSP timing evidence.
claims.ppt_claim: Rolling shutter, line timing, stage latency, AE/AWB delay, DMA/queue/bandwidth.
claims.recommended_action: Block latency sign-off until board traces and 3A telemetry are attached.

claims.gap_detail: Task model profiles exist, but no trained model loop or dataset-specific evaluation evidence is included.
claims.ppt_claim: MTF/OTF, Delta E, SNR/VSNR, perceptual difference, mAP/mIoU task metrics.
claims.recommended_action: Treat model outputs as adapter metrics until training/evaluation manifests are provided.

claims.current_evidence: fileio.py supports DNG read and sensor_dng_read; dataset.py exports NPZ/TIFF/container
claims.gap_detail: Standards-compliant DNG writer remains intentionally missing.
claims.ppt_claim: Sensor and RAW module table includes DNG RAW read/write.
claims.recommended_action: Use optional DNG-like ZIP container for research packaging; keep true DNG writer as separate milestone.

claims.gap_detail: Reports are evidence snapshots and not automated product QA dashboards.
claims.ppt_claim: HTML/PPT/JSON reports, plots, metric tables, task results.

claims.gap_detail: Field/angle fidelity is only as strong as attached optics/sensor assets.
claims.ppt_claim: Field, angle, illuminant, color, artifact, control delay, use-case scenario analysis.
claims.recommended_action: Use FACA for ranking and sensitivity, not final accuracy without calibration.

claims.current_evidence: optimization.py with grid/random/LHS/evolutionary/GP/surrogate, constraints, Pareto, escalation plan
claims.gap_detail: Hardware-in-loop and measured calibration objectives are still external.
claims.ppt_claim: Discrete/continuous design variables, constraints, Pareto frontier, sweep table, updated design loop.
claims.recommended_action: Route selected candidates through physics escalation and calibration evidence gates.

claims.gap_detail: Automatic label synthesis for arbitrary scenes is not implemented.
claims.ppt_claim: RAW, labels, metadata, versioned/indexed training datasets.
claims.recommended_action: Accept caller/synthetic-helper labels and preserve lineage.

claims.current_evidence: dataset.py exports RAW NPZ, sensor_digital, RGB preview, per-stage NPZ, labels JSON
claims.gap_detail: OI photon/irradiance export and EXR/HDR scene files are not complete dataset formats.
claims.ppt_claim: Bayer RAW, OI photons/irradiance, sensor volts, sRGB, per-stage outputs, metadata, annotations.
claims.recommended_action: Add OI/stage exports incrementally without claiming measured RAW.

claims.current_evidence: dataset.py preserves caller label payloads; task_perception.py supports boxes/masks/pose/tracking
claims.gap_detail: No general automatic label inference or mask generation from arbitrary RGB scenes.
claims.ppt_claim: Boxes, masks, semantic masks, keypoints, polylines, stage tags, quality and perception metrics.
claims.recommended_action: Use synthetic helpers or caller-provided labels only.

claims.current_evidence: dataset split policy, checksums, optional uncertainty proxy maps
claims.gap_detail: Calibrated baseline and true uncertainty posterior require measured references.
claims.ppt_claim: Train/val/test split, reference images, calibrated pipeline baseline, uncertainty/confidence map.
claims.recommended_action: Keep proxy confidence maps separate from calibration confidence.

claims.current_evidence: db_catalog.py, calibration.py, physics_pipeline.py, goal gate sign-off guard
claims.gap_detail: Measured silicon sign-off evidence is absent by design.
claims.ppt_claim: Empirical proxy through ISETCam numerical, RayOptics, FDTD, TCAD, measured calibration.
claims.recommended_action: Continue blocking calibrated tier until required external evidence validates.

claims.current_evidence: physics_pipeline.py detects active FDTD/TCAD run mismatch
claims.gap_detail: Current active FDTD LUT and TCAD generation map are from different run roots.
claims.ppt_claim: FDTD LUT and TCAD/DEVSIM collection proxy with accuracy gate.
claims.recommended_action: Regenerate TCAD generation map from active FDTD LUT or repoint both to one lineage.

claims.current_evidence: pytest suite, parity_report.py, render_* tools, reports/camerae2e_goal
claims.gap_detail: Risk/design-decision records are not yet first-class generated artifacts.
claims.ppt_claim: Unit tests, parity cases, HTML/JSON reports, design decisions, risk records.
claims.recommended_action: Promote PPT gap audit and goal gate reports as evidence snapshots.

claims.current_evidence: db_catalog.py registry and bundled/external asset discovery
claims.gap_detail: Several catalogs are proxy, metadata-derived, stale, or missing measured evidence.
claims.ppt_claim: Lens DB, Sensor FDTD LUT, TCAD/DEVSIM DB, HW ISP profiles, task model profiles, MATLAB parity baselines.
claims.recommended_action: Use registry readiness and calibration evidence plan before stronger claims.
